original.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 adds an optional spec.apiCall.retryLimit field (integer, minimum 1, default 3) to the v2alpha1 GlobalContextEntry CRD, providing built-in retry logic so that apiCall requests that initially fail are retried 3 times by default.

decision.reason: [ev-a6027c299092] says Kyverno 1.13 adds an optional retryLimit to apiCall in the kyverno.io/v2alpha1 GlobalContextEntry. It also says the field defaults to 3. [ev-eb301d25a0b7] shows the field is new in 1.13.0, with nothing before it, at spec.versions[name=v2alpha1]…spec.properties.apiCall.properties.retryLimit with default 3. The CRD schema validators also confirmed that spec.apiCall.retryLimit is new in the v2alpha1 schema [ev-3f8a3adffa22, ev-6032b12f614d]. So the subject (crd-field, kyverno.io, v2alpha1, GlobalContextEntry, spec.apiCall.retryLimit) and the change (added, after 3) are supported.
